admission.justification: Adding reason text to the exact state mark breaks the state vocabulary, while hiding the reason removes the evidence needed to judge currentness.

applicability: Currentness labels and owner-supplied reasons on expression-card entries.
conditions: Each non-current entry mark contains exactly its entry, state and side.
A supplied reason remains visible beside that mark with the same entry and side, outside disclosures.
exclusions: Generating a missing reason, changing the recorded state or appending reason text inside the exact state mark.

evidence: ExpressionCards.test.tsx F4 exact-text case green; worklistRepair.test.tsx F06 reason-sibling case green (s3-f4f06.log: 20/20 together)

statement: A not-current card entry is marked with its exact MIK-R03 state text, and a recorded reason reads beside the mark outside any disclosure.
